name: Arukenimon & Mummymon
main_effect:
[Your Turn] When [Arukenimon] or [Mummymon] would be played from your hand, by deleting this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 3.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with [Myotismon] in its text from your trash without paying the cost. At the next end of your opponent's turn, delete it.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
